subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should CodexBar keep Usage & Spend as a permanent top-level Settings destination, or place the same aggregation inside the existing shared overview experience?
rationale: The implementation and proof do not determine the desired long-term information architecture or whether the maintenance cost of another permanent Settings destination is acceptable.

options.title: Approve dedicated pane
options.body: Land the dashboard as a persistent top-level Settings destination with its current local-only and identity-free data boundary.

options.title: Integrate existing overview
options.body: Preserve the aggregation model but move its presentation into the existing shared Overview or another established destination before merge.

options.title: Decline the surface
options.body: Do not add a permanent cross-provider spend dashboard and retain the current provider-specific and menu overview experiences.

recommendation.title: Approve dedicated pane
recommendation.body: Land the dashboard as a persistent top-level Settings destination with its current local-only and identity-free data boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and merger of the adjacent Overview work, steipete is the strongest available owner for the permanent product-placement decision.
